messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: As of 2026-03-09, Priya is off the Team Atlas on-call rotation. [valid 2026-03-09 to 2026-04-23; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09]
- In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya; Tomasz Nowak transferred to Team Dune on 2025-07-02. [valid 2025-07-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-02]
    earlier: In 2025, Team Atlas consists of Priya and Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2025-01-06 to 2025-07-02; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-06]

- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]

- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- As of 2025-07-02, Team Atlas continues without Tomasz Nowak. [valid 2025-07-02 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-02]
- On the 2026-02-04 rotation day, Team Dune's on-call swapped and Tomasz Nowak carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-02-04]
- On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-13]
- Team Atlas runs its planning meeting on Tuesdays. [valid 2025-10-31 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-31]
- On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-29]
- On 2025-09-08, the Team Boreal on-call swapped and Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08]

- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas observed that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the notifier is not Team Atlas's service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
